edges.reason: initialize writes the provider argument into the addressesProvider state variable
onlyPoolAdmin reads addressesProvider.getPoolAdmin() to authorise batchInitReserve
onlyPoolAdmin reads addressesProvider.getPoolAdmin() to authorise configureReserveAsCollateral
msg.sender must equal the configured pool admin before batchInitReserve executes
msg.sender must equal the configured pool admin before configureReserveAsCollateral executes
msg.sender must equal the configured emergency admin before setPoolPause executes
batchInitReserve reads the pool state variable into cachedPool before iterating
configureReserveAsCollateral reads and writes reserve configuration through the pool state variable
setReserveInterestRateStrategyAddress forwards the asset and strategy through the pool state variable
updateAToken reads pool reserve data through the pool state variable
the pool state variable is the receiver of the state-mutating external configuration calls
_checkNoLiquidity reads reserve data from the pool state variable
the initializer modifier calls getRevision to guard initialize against repeated initialization
the calldata input array drives the loop inside batchInitReserve
the provider parameter flows into the addressesProvider state variable in initialize
the asset parameter selects the reserve being configured in configureReserveAsCollateral
cachedPool is forwarded as the pool argument of _initReserve
the implementation parameter is forwarded to _upgradeTokenImplementation
batchInitReserve calls _initReserve for each entry of the input array
_initReserve calls _initTokenWithProxy to deploy the aToken and debt token proxies
_initReserve passes the deployed proxy addresses into pool.initReserve and pool.setConfiguration
updateAToken calls _upgradeTokenImplementation with the aToken proxy address
updateStableDebtToken calls _upgradeTokenImplementation with the stable debt token proxy address
updateVariableDebtToken calls _upgradeTokenImplementation with the variable debt token proxy address
_initTokenWithProxy deploys a proxy and its initialize call delegatecalls into the implementation with caller-supplied init params
_upgradeTokenImplementation invokes upgradeToAndCall which delegatecalls the new implementation, handing it full control during the upgrade

normalization_plan.reason: the provider parameter is a per-call argument of the initialize function and is directly stored into the addressesProvider state variable by that function
the input array parameter is the sole driver of the loop in batchInitReserve and has no meaning outside that function
the asset parameter identifies the reserve addressed by configureReserveAsCollateral and is only used within that configuration workflow
cachedPool is a local cache of the pool state variable consumed only by the batchInitReserve loop and the internal _initReserve calls it makes
the implementation parameter is the address that the proxy delegatecalls into via upgradeToAndCall, so it normalizes into the unsafe upgrade operation
